## Research status

**Technical owners.** 4 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Human Intent as a Formal Input](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/human-intent-as-a-formal-input.html), [Human Factors and Meaningful Control in Oversight](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/human-factors-and-meaningful-control-in-oversight.html), [Human-AI Communication, Persuasion, and Epistemic Security](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/human-ai-communication-persuasion-and-epistemic-security.html), [Command Contracts: From Intent to Executable Work](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/intent-to-execution-contracts.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 15.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** User studies showing lighter clarification and control mechanisms produce fewer consequential intent and manipulation failures at lower burden would narrow the contract.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
:::
